snippet.title: Old Thiess: The Werewolf's Trial - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Release trailer for Old Thiess: The Werewolf's Trial, a game that combines exploration, combat, and the intensity of a 2D platformer with the interactivity of a narrative game where the player's actions influence the outcome of the story.

Available for download on itch.io.
